mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more commonplace method to gather information."
Sampling is the more commonplace method to gather information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circle divided into pie-shaped pieces proportional to its relative size."
A pie chart is a circle divided into pie-shaped pieces proportional to its relative size.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of all individuals, items or data under consideration in a statistical study."
Population is a collection of all individuals, items or data under consideration in a statistical study.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-parametric or distribution-free statistical technique."
The Spearman's Rank Order Correlation Coefficient is a non-parametric or distribution-free statistical technique.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of the measurement divided by the number of measurements in the set."
The mean is the sum of the measurement divided by the number of measurements in the set.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of size 625 from the given population of systolic blood pressure measurements."
possible sample means of size 625 from the given population of systolic blood pressure measurements.
fib: ______ is an act in statistics whereby an analyst tests an assumption regarding a population parameter.
Hypothesis testing is an act in statistics whereby an analyst tests an assumption regarding a population parameter.
______ is referred to as the confidence level.
The confidence percentage is referred to as the confidence level.
______ is a pictorial representation which shows the relationship between a variable of interest (Dependent variable) and that on which this variable of interest depends (independent variable).
A graph is a pictorial representation which shows the relationship between a variable of interest (Dependent variable) and that on which this variable of interest depends (independent variable).
______ is the science that deals with collecting and summarizing facts which are expressible in numerical form.
Statistics is the science that deals with collecting and summarizing facts which are expressible in numerical form.
______ is the event that the card selected is 8 B is the event that the card selected is 10.
Suppose A is the event that the card selected is 8 B is the event that the card selected is 10.
